units.source_text: 传右卫门首先说了这样一段引子，接着开始长篇大论的讲起谈起内藏助一年前放浪形骸的逸事。

en.t: Denemon first offered this preface, then began at great length to tell anecdotes of Kuranosuke's dissolute behavior a year earlier.

units.source_text: 去高尾和爱宕去赏红叶时他也装疯，心里肯定非常痛苦啊。

en.t: Even when he went to Takao and Atago to view the autumn leaves, he pretended to be mad; surely he must have been suffering terribly inside.

units.source_text: 因为一直要搞苦肉计，想必他在岛原和祇园参加赏樱花宴会也一定非常痛苦……

en.t: Because he had to keep up that painful ruse, even attending cherry blossom banquets in Shimabara and Gion must surely have been terribly hard for him.
